statements.text: Summarize integer rows into a report containing their total.
A caller supplies integer rows and export/writable flags to summarize.

sources.quote: func summarize(rows []int, export bool, writable bool) Report {

statements.text: The loop adds each row into total and stores it in Report.Total.
The function returns the report containing that total.
When export is true, the function calls writeReport with the created report.
Investigate how export and writable control the writeReport call.

review.reason: The story coherently explains the summarization input, mechanism, result, and a source-supported next investigation, but its export claim materially misstates the nested control flow. The handoff does not repair that incorrect narration.

decisions.reason: The initialization, summing loop, and Report construction support the stated purpose and source visual.
The signature accepts integer rows and both boolean flags, as narrated and displayed.
Lines 2–4 directly show accumulation into total and assignment to Report.Total.
The report constructed with the accumulated total is returned after the conditional export block.

writeReport is nested under both export and writable. The narration incorrectly makes export alone sufficient, omitting the material writable precondition; the isolated call visual also omits both guards.
The explicit handoff proposes a useful investigation of the two actual enclosing guards controlling writeReport, supported by the cited code and visual.
